تلتزموا (form VIII)
# تَلْتَزِمُوا (taltazimū) /tal.ta.zi.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَزَمَ (iltazama)
# تُلْتَزَمُوا (tultazamū) /tul.ta.za.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَزَمَ (iltazama)
